kind: author self-review; independent review/QA remains open

correctness.evidence: 15 deterministic combat cases and 9 native/playback cases cover actual positive HP basis, rank1/2/20, minimum, overkill/orbs, miss/basic/DoT/CD exclusions, personal pools/MP bypass, reflection ordering, lethal hero/orphan closure and deterministic immutable replay. Strict schema prohibits valid self-cost/recovery composition, avoiding stale-owner overwrite.

readability.evidence: Authored readonly OnHitSelfDamageTuning copied to registered damage payload; bounded direct debit at the existing real-HP post-hit boundary. UI uses pure display model and existing i18n stat/paragraph patterns.

architecture.evidence: Pure TS engine remains DOM/React-free; numerical tuning stays in validated JSON. Existing death/playback/save22/native class/rank/selection authority retained; no global rates, migrations, dependencies or CI changes.

security.evidence: Finite positive schema metadata, exact Sacrifice identity, foreign/contradictory rejection and native authority tests; no credential/permission/network or persistence expansion.

performance.evidence: Constant-time arithmetic and one shallow unit copy/event per eligible hit; no new RNG, recursive damage, unbounded collection or render subscription.

visuals.evidence: All four detail and four combat screenshots viewed. Changed bilingual rule text wraps and remains readable. Mobile log is below the viewport; exact retained log JSON proves actual cast/self damage. Existing navigation icon fallback and broader UI polish are outside this bounded acceptance.

limitations: Provisional8%/minimum1 tuning is not earned balance acceptance.
Synthetic L30/50k equipment browser fixtures do not prove class builds, campaign or pacing.
No independent reviewer/QA or whole-v1 signoff.
author_verdict: No blocking author finding; required bounded local checks pass. Independent/earned and whole-v1 evidence remains INCOMPLETE.
